rules.name: gate-rm-rf-root
rules.reason: [gate-rm-rf-root] Refusing recursive delete of / or home. Narrow the target or confirm explicitly.

rules.name: gate-secret-in-args
rules.reason: [gate-secret-in-args] Possible secret value in tool args. Use env references, never literal keys.

rules.name: gate-secret-assignment
rules.reason: [gate-secret-assignment] Secret assignment in shell command. Export keys outside the session, never inline.

rules.name: gate-git-force-push
rules.reason: [gate-git-force-push] No force-push or delete. Push a feature branch and open a PR instead.

rules.name: gate-git-hard-reset
rules.reason: [gate-git-hard-reset] git reset --hard destroys uncommitted work. Stash or commit instead.

rules.name: gate-git-discard
rules.reason: [gate-git-discard] git checkout/restore . discards all local changes. Name explicit paths instead.

rules.name: gate-git-protected-push
rules.reason: [gate-git-protected-push] Pushing to a protected branch. Open a PR instead, or approve when prompted.

rules.name: guide-ts-no-any
rules.text: guidance: ts-no-any — `: any`/`as any` spotted in a .ts edit; prefer unknown, a schema parse, or a named type (see skills/ts-review).
